title:
Stage 1 forge tier — increment 2c ONLY: the frozen tactic/simp battery (REQ-5). Authoritative spec: .design/stage1-forge-tier.md REQ-5 + AC-9; sequencing in .design/stage1-forge-tier-kickoff-plan.md. Builds on merged predecessors: the foundation (#20) added the Stuck verdict to CertVerdict; 2a (#29) parses proof { ... } blocks VERBATIM (tactic parsing was explicitly deferred to THIS increment); 2b (#42, merged) added the covenant gate. Follow the ACToR read-write-verify-commit loop; commit per coherent sub-unit; self-verify before each commit; revert anything that fails. IMPORTANT: run the doc-drift tripwire (python3 tooling/doc-drift.py) AND req-registry --check as part of your self-verify, and RE-PIN the audited-sha of any design doc whose governed source you touch (this was the one gap in 2b — do not repeat it). If low on time or budget, STOP at a sub-unit boundary and report what landed; the branch is resumable.

SCOPE: REQ-5 frozen battery ONLY. OUT OF SCOPE (do not build): anti-Goodhart re-elaboration (2d, REQ-6), goal/fill proof view (2e, REQ-7), relax engine (2f, REQ-8b), lemma library (3, REQ-9). REQ-3 surface (2a) and REQ-4 covenant (2b) are DONE — consume, do not redo.

DELIVERABLES:
1. The frozen tactic allowlist (omega, simp, nlinarith, induction, decide, calc, exact, from, push_neg) AND the frozen simp set ship as a REGISTRY DATA FILE modeled on the combinator registry (thermite-spec/src/combinators.rs static REGISTRY of frozen signature entries with a golden pin) — a single static, auditable, byte-deterministic source of truth.
2. Parse the tactics/simp-lemma citations inside the 2a proof blocks (2a captured them verbatim) and ENFORCE the allowlist AT ELABORATION on the Lean discharge path: a proof citing an unlisted tactic or an unlisted simp lemma is REFUSED (a hard error naming the offending tactic/lemma), NOT warned. 
3. Stuck verdicts (the CertVerdict variant from the foundation) carry battery hints: the residual goal + the missing-simp-bridge heuristic (RFC-1 section 8 transcript). A proof that elaborates but leaves a residual goal → Stuck(goals) with the residual + hint, never silently Proved.

GAUNTLET before each commit: cargo test -p forge (and -p thermite-spec if the registry lands there); cargo clippy -p <crate> --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo fmt --check; for any Lean touch, lake build + the axiom probe; doc-drift tripwire 0-drift (re-pin governed docs you touch); req-registry --check clean; forge check over conformance still matches all v1 golden certs with oracle_subset byte-identical for v1 items. AC-9 specifically: the battery registry file exists; a proof citing an unlisted tactic OR an unlisted simp lemma is refused with the name in the error (tested both); a Stuck verdict on the RFC merge example carries the residual goal and a missing-bridge hint (tested). No stubs/TODOs; fix warnings rather than suppress.

REGISTRY: register REQ-5 in .design/reqs/registry.toml as REQ-S1-5 with typed evidence; regenerate the status view; req-registry.py --check clean. Do NOT hand-write a ## REQ status comment table.

SCOPE GUARDS: no cage / combinator-menu change (the existing thermite-spec combinator REGISTRY signatures are untouched — the battery is a NEW separate registry, not an edit to the combinator one); do NOT flip the README/docs headline (G1 gate only, R-GATE-1); never stage .crosslink/hook-config.json or .claude/settings.json; additive certs only for v1 items. NOTE: git push is blocked for you by policy — commit locally, end with a clear summary, and the orchestrator will push + open the PR. One branch; the work is ONE increment (2c).
